question: What language support is required before hash-based generic library APIs can be expressed?
decision: Add a compile-time Hash capability, allow canonical capability conjunctions such as T: Eq + Hash, and expose hash(value) as a deterministic native operation without adding a runtime capability dictionary or a new cdbc opcode.

hash_contract.encoding: little-endian integer fields and UTF-8 byte strings
hash_contract.number_normalization: positive zero and one canonical NaN

in_scope: public interface and cdi round trips
C++ value hash utility and Rust VM parity
